verdict.rationale: TeamViewer publishes first-party API documentation for a Web API (webapi.teamviewer.com/api/v1/docs), and its pricing page lists API access alongside the audit log, so the product can be driven programmatically through a documented public API. The evidence is mostly titles, though, and the probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at common paths. Missing for 10: detail on which product operations the API covers, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
